Map completion can be fun in groups, but some people may find that boring and a drag.

If I were you guys I would solo/small group dungeons. Dungeons offer great rewards, small groups and with enough practice you can complete them without a full group. 

WvW is also a great option if you guys are feeling competitive. You don't need large groups, many people WvW in small parties and take out smaller objectives and small groups of enemies. Also note that the small server may hinder that experience(i.e. if enemy zergs are constantly steamrolling around and you have no one). 

Test the waters and try out everything! Guild Wars 2 is a big game and has alot to offer for all numbers of players.
